features.description: Six coins start a hold-and-win round with a 5,000x Grand jackpot.

review:
BGaming's tribute to the old western and animal slots – sharper graphics, same retro feel, on a 5x3 grid with wilds and two bonuses.

Free spins only use high-paying symbols, and six or more coins open Gold Respin, a hold-and-win round where the 5,000x Grand jackpot is the target. Very high volatility, a 5,624x max and 96.14% RTP. Free spins about once every 182 spins. Built on the same frame as Gold Rush – Johnny Cash and Dragon Age Hold & Win.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
